blocks.text: الاحتمال الحقيقي: If it rains, I will stay home.
الافتراض: If I had money, I would travel (لو كان معي مال لسافرت).
الماضي المستحيل: If I had known, I would have come (لو عرفت لأتيت).
If you heat ice, it melts.
I would go if I could.

sentences.t: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.

sentences.t: If the loser smiled the winner will lose the thrill of victory.

sentences.t: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.

sentences.t: If you ironed Switzerland, it would be bigger than Germany.

sentences.t: Ah! If I were rich, I'd buy myself a house in Spain.
